[Help, legend, allergy info, consults, alternative antimicrobials and more \(Inpt\)](general-information-inpatient)

# Antimicrobial Prophylaxis for Urological Procedures

Single-dose antimicrobial prophylaxis is appropriate in the majority of

uncomplicated urologic cases.

[<Click here> AUA Surgery Abx Prophylaxis Guidelines](orz-gtx-abx-aua-surgery-prophyl)

# If no prophylaxis recommended, enter order:

[*No antimicrobial prophylaxis recommended order](orz-gtx-abx-pre-op-url-nurse-generic-order)

# Endoscopic procedures:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

< OR >

[Ampicillin 2gram IV ONCE AND Gentamicin 5mg/kg IV ONCE Preop](orz-set-abx-ampicillin-2gm-and-gentamicin-5mg-kg-preop)

**Alternative for allergy to penicillin/cephalosporin:

[Click here Beta-lactam reaction assessment](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Levofloxacin 500mg IVPB ONCE Preop](psjizid-levofloxacin-500mg-iv-once-preop)

**Alternative for allergy to both cephalosporins and fluoroquinolones:

[Clindamycin 900mg IV once <AND> Gentamicin 5mg/kg Weight Based once pre-op](orz-set-abx-clindamycin-900mg-gentamicin-5mg-kg-preop)

**Additional single agents:

[Gentamicin 5mg/kg Weight Based Dosing Preop](surg-gentamicin-weight-based-dosing)

< OR >

[Ciprofloxacin 400mg IV ONCE Preop](psjizid-ciprofl-400mg-iv-once-surg-preop)

< OR >

[Ciprofloxacin 500 mg po x1 give in clinic](psczid-ciprofloxacin-500mg-x1-given-in-clinic)

< OR >

[Fluconazole 400mg IV ONCE Preop](psjizid-fluconazole-400mg-iv-once-preop)

# Open/Robotic procedures:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

**Alternative for cephalosporin allergy:

[Click here Beta-lactam reaction assessment](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

Select alternative from Endoscopic procedures above

# Cystectomy/large bowel/vaginal procedures:

[Cefazolin Weight Based IV ONCE AND Metronidazole 500mg IV ONCE Preop](orz-set-abx-cefazo-wt-based-iv-metron-500mg-iv-preop)

**Alternative for cephalosporin allergy:

[Click here Beta-lactam reaction assessment](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Levofloxacin 500mg IVPB ONCE Preop](psjizid-levofloxacin-500mg-iv-once-preop)

# Implants:

[Cefazolin Weight Based IV ONCE AND Gentamicin 5mg/kg IV ONCE Preop](orz-set-abx-cefazolin-wt-based-ivpb-gentamicin-5mg-kg-iv-preop)

**Alternative for cephalosporin allergy:

[Click here Beta-lactam reaction assessment](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV ONCE AND Gentamicin 5mg/kg IV ONCE Preop](orz-set-abx-vanco-15mg-kg-gentamicin-5mg-kg-iv-preop)

# Soak Solution for Penile Implant prior to implantation in OR

[Penile Implant Soak \(Gentamicin 50MG and Rifampin 500MG\) prior to implantation](orz-set-abx-gentamicin-50mg-rifampin-500mg-penile-implant-soak)
